text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. Passport sized photo*2. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity).*3. Valid non-criminal record report (within 6 months)*4. English proficiency test certificate*5. Notarized previous school diploma or degree certificateAccording to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.*6. Notarized official transcriptsAccording to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: academic transcript in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.*7. Bank Statement (enough to cover your expenses)*8. A photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form(within 6 months)*9. Passport blank page*10. Statement of guarantor
